item.title: Renowned Iranian novelist and travel writer Reza Amirkhani passes away at 53
item.description: Amirkhani gained widespread recognition with his 1999 novel Man-e Ou (The Self of Him), a work that drew on extensive research into old Tehran and explored themes of love, identity, tradition, and social change.

item.title: Acting oil minister says crude oil to be sold on domestic bourse in coming days
item.description: Bovard says the ministry is actively addressing export bottlenecks through reorganized sales strategies.

item.title: Iran to inaugurate Chabahar-Zahedan railway in February, linking oceanic port to national network
item.description: The 631-kilometer railway will connect the Shahid Beheshti port to the national grid, creating a direct transit route for landlocked Central Asian states and Afghanistan.

item.title: IRGC shoots down 20th US MQ-1 drone over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The IRGC warns that any violation of Iran's airspace will be met with a harsh, decisive, and powerful response.

item.title: Iran’s top security official to Trump: ‘Old world order cannot be restored with old photos’
item.description: Mohsen Rezaee described the United States as a “defeated” country rather than victorious in its wars against Iran.

item.title: Iran, Pakistan to finalize free trade agreement as bilateral commerce hits $6bn
item.description: The agreement is expected to be signed by the end of the current Persian year, reducing customs costs and expanding market access for both nations.

item.title: External pressure won’t affect Iran-Russia cooperation at Bushehr nuclear power plant: Rosatom
item.description: Russia’s state-run Rosatom says the Bushehr nuclear power plant “passed a test of resilience” during the US-Israeli war of aggression against Iran.

item.title: Iranian MP warns US that Tehran's threats ‘real and actionable’
item.description: MP Ebrahim Rezaei stated that the United States now faces a clear choice between submitting to Iran’s missile power or pursuing genuine diplomacy.

item.title: IRGC targets US military positions in Bahrain in missile and drone operation
item.description: The IRGC Public Relations Department said the operation was conducted in direct response to continued violations of Iranian airspace by US drones and broader hostile actions by the American military.

item.title: US can never dominate Strait of Hormuz: Iranian Army spokesman
item.description: Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia says the Army will defend Iran’s rights in the Strait of Hormuz until the enemy’s final defeat.

item.title: Araghchi: Hormuz will stay closed until US accepts Iran’s ‘reasonable, lawful’ conditions
item.description: The foreign minister says reopening the Strait of Hormuz would not be difficult if the US accepted Iran’s reasonable conditions under international law.

item.title: Iran views US blockade as act of war, will take ‘any measure’ to break it: Deputy FM
item.description: Gharibabadi says the US blockade of Iran’s maritime trade is an act of war, and Tehran will do everything necessary to break it.

item.title: Swimmer warns of war's environmental toll in Hormuz
item.description: British swimmer raises concern over the environmental toll of war and the threat to marine life in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Saudi airstrikes severely damage oil facilities, injure at least six in Sana'a
item.description: The Saudi airstrikes targeted a station and the headquarters of the Yemen Petroleum Company in the capital, Sana'a early Sunday, injuring at least six employees and damaging facilities.

item.title: About 50 people missing after deadly Indonesian factory fire
item.description: Indonesian police said a fire that broke out at a candy factory in Banten province on Saturday night had not been fully extinguished, with seven body bags recovered and about 50 people still unaccounted for.
